blogs.title: Why Tokenization Might Be Holding Back Your AI: Introducing Dynamic Patches
blogs.description: An overview of how current Large Language Models rely on rigid 'token' systems that treat all text equally regardless of difficulty. This post explains the concept of 'patches'—dynamic groups of bytes that allow models to intelligently allocate computing power, spending more resources on complex parts of text (like math) and less on predictable ones.

blogs.title: Scaling Smarter: How BLT Trains Larger Models Without Breaking the Budget
blogs.description: Deep dive into the 'Fixed-Inference Scaling' methodology. Readers will learn how BLT changes the rules of game for model expansion: instead of trading performance for speed, you can actually get *better* performance by combining bigger model sizes with larger patch sizes, all while staying within a strict compute limit.
